headline: Newsom signs California laws limiting employers' use of AI on workers
summary: Governor Gavin Newsom signed laws aimed at protecting California workers from AI-driven job losses and surveillance, including a ban on using the technology to predict a worker's emotional state from biometric data. Coverage notes California is one of the first states to roll out such workplace regulations, which could pave the way for broader AI safeguards across the US.
